Description: Hero rebuilt: severity/status/emergency promoted to the first line and enlarged, ticket ID as the headline, action bar given a deterministic full-width row (buttons no longer relocate when a stale-report warning appears), Incident/Event demoted to eyebrow text, OLA badge added, and Critical-on-emergency contrast fixed with a white ring.

Dropped the mandatory category + justification modal that stood between a claimed Wazuh alert and the ticket form. Creating a ticket is the only forward move at triage, so there was no decision to justify; the Ticket / Project Incident routing fork became two direct buttons. Critical triage OLA is 30 min measured from incident time, so the modal was spending that budget.

Feature: Ticket edit gating and Tier 2 claim visibility
Description: Edit now honours the Tier 2 claim (transition_to already did, the edit surface did not, so a second analyst could rewrite content the claimer was reading). Added an out-of-court warning naming the current holder, and surfaced claim state plus a one-click Claim button on ticket detail so claims are visible without a queue round-trip.

Three tabs with live counts replace three stacked cards; the manual-intake queue previously sat ~1100px down, below the fold. Ticket table paginated at 10 (this was the only queue in the app without a Paginator). Tab state survives claim/release/dismiss so an analyst is not bounced out mid-triage.

Member tickets can be stepped back again (previously refused with an error pointing at a page that had no such control, and a stepped-back member would have stranded with no forward path). Shared evidence brought to full parity with ticket attachments: post-creation upload, soft delete with reason, manager restore, hardened download. OLA added to the group page, lead facts made deterministic across viewers, manual-triage provenance surfaced.

A multi-system Project Incident counted as N incidents in executive KPIs. Headline counts, MoM delta, closure rate and active-emergency now count a bundle once; status-grain rows (OLA, court, pipeline) deliberately stay per-ticket. fact_ticket now exposes bundle identity and agg_ticket_daily.incident_count is deduped.

Filter pills with live counts replace dropdowns plus submit button, so the stage split is visible without filtering three times; sort auto-submits. Table narrowed 1115px to 977px (fits 1280px laptops) by dropping the Emergency column, merging Tier 1 into the system cell and constraining the description width. Added bundle indicator and relative queue age.

Feature: Wazuh Triage queue controls and pagination fix
Description: Same pill-with-counts treatment applied for consistency. Fixed a genuine dead end: the paginator rendered a page counter with no prev/next links at all, so beyond 25 alerts pages 2+ were unreachable. Removed three dead context variables computed on every request.

Searching an exact ticket number returned every ticket in the database: ts_rank returns 1e-20 rather than 0 for a non-match, so the rank>0 predicate was true for every row. Replaced Postgres full-text with substring matching, which also makes partial ticket IDs, subnet prefixes and Thai text searchable (full-text collapses a space-less Thai run into one lexeme). Fixed the Triage Records card showing to non-SOC roles; added real pagination and honest totals.

Verification consolidated to Tier 2: Tier 1 had a second verdict-shaped step that asked the same question it had answered one screen earlier. Lane then collapsed to a single Tier 1 relay action, with Tier 1 granted upload rights while awaiting the owner (previously only the system owner could attach, and owners never log in, so nobody could).

No index exists; a bundle is reachable only via a member ticket badge or a direct URL. Cannot answer 'which bundles are open'. Declined 2026-08-13 on sidebar-clutter grounds; recorded in case it resurfaces.

Exported DOCX/PDF never states that a ticket belongs to a Project Incident, so five member reports read as five standalone incidents. Needs the context dict, the build script and the committed binary template changed in lockstep (two tests enforce this).

Feature: Notify System Owner when work is assigned
Description: Nothing fires on entering AWAITING_OWNER. The owner is emailed at ticket creation and at closure but never when the manager actually hands them the work. Consistent with an out-of-band lane today; needed if owners ever self-serve.

assigned_admin is frozen once a ticket leaves T1_REVIEW and can_submit_containment binds to that one account, so a ticket assigned to the wrong or absent admin is un-actionable by anyone but a superuser. Deferred 2026-08-13 as not currently needed.

Feature: Tier 2 queue: show what is being verified
Description: Verification-stage rows display issue_description (the original problem) rather than containment_report (what Tier 2 is there to check). Roughly 77 percent of the queue is a verification stage.

Header reads 'IP Source' but renders device_name; the ip_address that matched is never displayed; no severity/OLA/bundle badge unlike other lists. ProjectIncident is not searchable at all (cannot find a bundle by PI code).

Feature: Make returned cases actionable in My Queue
Description: The alert says N cases were returned from Tier 2 but offers no link or filter to them, and rows are sorted by OLA so a returned case can sit on page 2 while page 1 shows none.

RefreshConcurrentlyTests (apps/reporting) is a TransactionTestCase without serialized_rollback; it truncates tables and drops migration-seeded ThreatGuidance rows, so every later --keepdb run reports four unrelated failures. Wastes time on false regressions.

Feature: Mobile card layout for manual-intake queue
Description: Five columns plus dense actions rely on horizontal scrolling below 768px. Would need card-style rows with urgency, owner and a single primary action.

Feature: Mark superseded sections in workflow change log
Description: docs/architecture/workflow-change-log.md sections 1 and 2 are titled 'CURRENT implementation' and 'TARGET workflow (implemented)' but are relative to the 2026-07-08 redesign and superseded by the sections above them. Section 2b still shows CONTAINMENT_REPORTED to APPROVED as TIER1_CREATOR ('T1 closes'), which has been Tier 2 for weeks.
